traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Elaeagnaceae: leaves usually alternate, rarely opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite, polygamous or dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup present; stems woody; perianth tepals; fruit achene; stamens (2-) 4 to 8 (-12); carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
